goal: Bring Jichi Insight to production graduation as a nationwide municipality insight platform. Continue autonomous, evidence-grounded expansion from the current Phase 15 state through full intended municipality coverage, canonical review/publication readiness, pipeline hardening, public-product alignment, and final runtime verification without collapsing fiscal/document/version distinctions or inventing unsupported policy claims.
graduation_criteria: The intended nationwide municipality universe is represented in the canonical coverage model, with every in-scope municipality either backed by a valid evidence package/state or explicitly tracked as unresolved rather than silently omitted.

Municipality evidence preserves official-source URLs, stable locators, plan/version/period/fiscal/availability boundaries, source precision, provenance, and deferred-depth semantics; unpublished facts, causal claims, unverified comparisons, and score-like judgments are never invented.

Candidate generation, validation, review staging, canonical promotion, and public-data workflows are deterministic, bounded, resumable, and free of known machine-resolvable blockers while preserving explicit human-only review boundaries where policy requires them.
The public Jichi Insight product is aligned with the current canonical nationwide dataset and its core browse/search/detail behavior passes repository and production/runtime smoke checks.

Repository CI, regression suites, data-quality audits, and final runtime verification are green with no unresolved implementation blocker; any true human-only publication/review gate is surfaced explicitly rather than bypassed.
